scope: Installed Python S01 text/vector-bearing/hybrid subset on exact source 224e44c59 post-Slice-132 product bytes after edge-explanation and importance-lookup repairs; not the full Phase 1 protocol
revision_reason: Refreeze the unchanged measured workload, counts, order and analysis after three test-first engine row-error repairs. Candidate source 224e44c59 and rebuilt installed wheel supersede the prior d465cd56d timing for this checkpoint.
candidate_artifact_note: Non-editable wheel from clean detached 224e44c59 source passed 72 installed S01 calls at 32/256 rows, three seeded query shapes, and independent result/byte audit. Wheel metadata remains 0.8.26 before release bump.
timing_boundary: Installed Python method invocation through materialized SearchResult; corpus setup, model loading and semantic verification excluded
pair_summary_rule: Report all five per-pair deltas, their median and full observed range for every size/query/statistic; no significance claim or regression threshold from five pairs
resource_rule: Report GNU Time child user/system CPU, peak RSS, filesystem block I/O, major faults and swap per block; do not attribute whole-worker resources to an individual query
cold_rule: Report each session-first observation as a diagnostic; do not call it cold OS/model cache or calculate a cold percentile
invalid_block_rule: Preserve every attempt. Require clean source checkout, installed wheel byte match, exact protocol and runner hashes, semantic checks on every result, 1000 valid warm observations per cell, stable host/CPU/storage/governor, no competing build/profiler, at least 1 GiB free and zero measured-child swap events. Host-only swap drift is a recorded warning with sensitivity analysis.
candidate_verdict_rule: Diagnostic latency comparison only. Report regressions, improvements and uncertainty separately from accepted release gates; do not infer correctness from version agreement.
phase1_limit: This S01 Python subset cannot close the complete installed-SDK functional exercise, S02, E01-E12, Pareto, robustness or logic/exception matrices.

candidate_product_snapshot.rule: A change to installed wheel bytes, engine source tree, Python package tree or Cargo.lock requires a new candidate artifact and affected-cell reruns; documentation and test-only commits do not alter this measured product snapshot.
